items.en: Fit the rig on a wearer: cap on, mount tight, phone seated so it cannot slip.
Set the angle: first person, hands and the work in frame. Not the torso, not the floor. Check it at every restart.
Run one full 30-minute cycle on a test phone: start, the buzz, restart per the procedure.
Sweep the floor at the buzz as the backup for every restart.
Say it and show it: hat off means tap stop. Footage of a ceiling is fraud.
Read storage and battery on a phone. A storage warning means swap in a spare and flush that phone first.
Issue a phone at clock-in by device number and write it in the wearer log. Confirm the wearer is logged into their own account, never someone else's.
Return a phone at clock-out with the condition tick: screen, port, mount, battery.
Dock every phone at shift end and confirm the collection app is uploading before you leave. Nothing sleeps holding more than a day of footage.

Name the eight fraud patterns from memory: idle recording, hat off while recording, camera at torso or floor, chest mount, filming someone else, staged tasks, screen recording, repeating after correction.
Say the absence rule: call and message your Portfolio Manager by 10 PM the night before. No reply in 20 minutes, call Moharam.
Say who to call for a broken phone, a phone dark at noon, an injury, a worker who looks under 18, and someone asking who the client is.

passes.en: Fits a rig, runs one clean cycle on a test phone, and answers the who-to-call questions without looking. The Portfolio Manager signs.

length.en: One day, before the first shift

items.en: Pass every line of the anchor module first.
Run the 30-minute sweep across 50 phones: walk the floor at the buzz, check every angle, restart what did not restart.
Run the noon dark-phone check: find every phone with no uploads by noon, send its anchor to it, and tell the Portfolio Manager the same hour.
Cover an absent anchor's ten phones without dropping the sweep.
Set rotations so no wearer sits on one task all week.
Stop a worker on the spot for missing PPE, hat off while recording, or looking under 18. Tell the Portfolio Manager before filming resumes.
Run the injury response: stop recording, help the person, site medical staff and the Portfolio Manager immediately. The Portfolio Manager tells Moharam and Adham within 30 minutes.
Lay out cables and charging stations so nobody trips and nothing touches the site's machinery. Tether phones on elevated work.
Run the shift-end count: every phone back, condition ticked, docked, uploading. A phone not returned goes to the Portfolio Manager before anyone goes home.
Deliver a flag to a worker: show the session, name the pattern, give one specific correction, the same day.

passes.en: One full shift on the floor with the Portfolio Manager watching: sweep, noon check, shift-end count, nothing missed. The Portfolio Manager signs.

length.en: One week, before taking a book

items.en: Pass the anchor and supervisor modules. Work one shift as an anchor.
Read your book: every site, its phones, its daily quota, its upload path. Say the monthly target and the rule: beat last month and the book grows, miss twice and it shrinks.
Send a wrap report to Mano: hours, active phones, hardware status, problems, fixes worth copying. Every evening, before the executive sync.
Run custody at a site: issue at clock-in by device number, return at clock-out with the condition tick, every transfer a registry event the same day.
Close a flag within 24 hours: session ID, account, what the flag says, what the worker says, the correction given. Second strike pauses the device. Three flags pulls the worker.
Read backlog in device-days. A site holding more than one device-day is an incident: call Moharam tonight. Put device-days per site in the wrap report.
Shadow Mazen on a Day 0: charging stations, labels, the network test from the floor, forms, orientation, pilot recordings reviewed before the second 30 minutes.
Run the onboarding gate with Mano's forms: ID copy, consent, fraud briefing sign-off, one account, wearer log, rig checked, signage posted. No device goes on anyone before every line is done.
Handle an absence: the call by 10 PM the night before, then the cover plan. A no-call, no-show is removal from the project.
Run the Thursday protocol: every device flushed before Friday, factory phones to a hub, hotels on their own lines.
Sit in on one executive sync. See how a site is judged against quota and what moves phones and people.
Say the three universal rules: operators start with their Portfolio Manager, Portfolio Managers start with Moharam, nobody contacts the client. Money and gear go to Mano, quality to Youssef Medhat.

passes.en: Two wrap reports in a row that Mano accepts without a question, and one flag closed within 24 hours. Moharam signs.

length.en: One hour, before the first run

items.en: Count the phones against the manifest: device IDs, count, site, time out, runner name. Count before you sign.
Pack a locked, unmarked case with the manifest inside. Never more than a third of a site's phones in one run. Above 60 phones, two runners on staggered runs.
Show the letter kit: the Arabic company letter on letterhead, a copy of the commercial register, the device list, two phone numbers that answer.
Sign custody at pickup and at drop. No signature, no handover.
Say the road rules: MDM tracking on, never stop en route, no runs after 11 PM, phones never go home.
Practice the checkpoint: hand over the letter, the register, and the manifest. Call Moharam. Never argue, never hide the count.
Say what to do if the vehicle is stolen or crashed: call Moharam first, police report the same day. MDM finds the phones.

passes.en: One supervised run with both custody signatures clean, and the checkpoint script said from memory. Moharam signs.

length.en: The calibration set, before the first live review

items.en: Score the calibration set: videos Youssef Medhat has already judged. Keep, flag, or delete, then compare against his verdicts.
Name each fraud pattern on sight: idle recording, hat off while recording, camera at torso or floor, chest mount, filming someone else, staged tasks, screen recording, repeating after correction.
Check angle, lighting, and movement on every video. A video rated "Great" is checked the same as any other.
Write a flag the worker can act on: session ID, account, the pattern, where in the video, and one specific correction.
Send every flag to the Portfolio Manager the same day, so the worker hears within 24 hours.
Say the ladder: second strike pauses the device until retraining, three flags pulls the worker, a worker removed for fraud is never re-enrolled.
Run one month-end audit pass with Youssef Medhat. Flagged footage is deleted before the invoice goes out.
Never contact a worker, a site, or the client. Every question goes through Youssef Medhat.

passes.en: Verdicts match Youssef Medhat's across the calibration set, and one written flag he would send as is. Youssef Medhat signs.

lines.en: The buzz is the cue. Restart every phone.
Sweep the floor. Check every angle: hands and the work in frame.
Hat off means tap stop. Ceiling footage is fraud.
Storage warning: swap in a spare, flush that phone first.
Issue by device number. Write it in the wearer log.
Own account only. Never someone else's.
Fit the rig. Check the angle before the first cycle.
No ID or consent on file: no phone.
Every phone back. Tick screen, port, mount, battery.
Dock it. Confirm the app is uploading before you leave.
Nothing sleeps holding more than a day of footage.
A phone missing: your Portfolio Manager, before anyone goes home.
Someone is hurt. Stop recording, help, site medical staff, then your Portfolio Manager.
A worker looks under 18 or has no ID. No phone on them.
A phone has uploaded nothing by noon.
Someone asks who the client is. Say nothing. Tell Moharam.
You cannot make tomorrow. Call and message by 10 PM tonight.

call.en: Your Portfolio Manager first. No reply in 20 minutes: Moharam.

lines.en: Count against the manifest. Sign only when it matches.
A third of the site's phones at most. Never more.
Locked, unmarked case. Manifest inside.
Letter, commercial register, device list, two numbers that answer. In the bag.
MDM tracking on for every phone.
Straight to the hub. Never stop en route.
No runs after 11 PM.
Phones never go home. Site, hub, or a signed-for case.
Vehicle stolen or crashed: call Moharam, then the police report the same day.
Hand over the letter, the register, and the manifest.
Call Moharam.
Never argue. Never hide the count.
Devices held: tell Moharam. Mano brings counsel the same day.
The attendant counts against the manifest. Both of you sign.
Custody signed at pickup and at drop. No signature, no handover.
Morning: take back only phones the hub has cleared, with a new manifest.

call.en: Moharam. If devices are held, Mano brings counsel the same day.
